A fuller discussion should be considered on the Breakthrough Phase III activities which could have serious adverse environmental effects and impacts. Full scale housing systems producers and their suppliers could use resources in an inefficient and wasteful way. Methods and way of exercising control over this problem should be developed before these resources are irretrievably committed.
We hope these comments are helpful to you in preparing your final environmental statement.
Sincerely yours,
J. B. NEWMAN
Colonel, Corps of Engineers Executive Director of Civil Works
